scope: Independent static review of frozen metadata retirement v3; no compilation, native tests or benchmarks
source_and_patch_checks: Five preimage source hashes match v10 native input manifest and author receipt
Fresh exact forward and reverse application matches all five fixed and preimage bytes
result: No additional definite blocker found in the inspected metadata retirement paths; this is not a release or production qualification.
reviewed_invariants: Closed is published before the close-cancellation guard or final Inner drop schedules cleanup.

A busy metadata slot triggers at most one live registered task per producer; it retains Shared, acquires the metadata slot without another held lock, and retires that slot's actual stream under the stream mutex.
An already-expired retirement deadline now physically drops the socket if immediately possible but returns Timeout; after an awaited lock the deadline is checked again.
New provisional connections enter the held slot before ApiVersions/SASL and remain protected by a cancellation/error guard; closed is rechecked at connect and handshake phase boundaries.
The new established-Metadata control gates a response, exercises both close timeout and cancellation, releases the RPC, and waits for a real TCP EOF.
TLS replacement test uses a held ApiVersions gate; its mock Close event is interpreted as handler termination rather than explicit TCP EOF.
known_limitations: Broader preexisting producer close-cancellation gap: if close is canceled after publishing closed but before shutdown_workers sends Ctrl::Close/aborts worker tasks, an idle non-sticky worker can remain parked while other Producer clones retain Inner. The new control creates no worker and proves only metadata cleanup.

Deferred retirement requires the captured Tokio runtime to keep progressing and the current metadata and stream lock owners eventually to release their locks. A timed-out/canceled close does not itself witness retirement; runtime shutdown can prevent completion.

An already-started handshake or RPC can continue until its phase returns; checks at await boundaries do not synchronously cancel an in-flight operation. Local retirement does not establish whether the broker applied any previous request.
TLS mock Close is a handler exit event, not a peer TCP EOF measurement. The held ApiVersions gate has source-only review and no dedicated drop/rearm runtime control.
No Rust type-check, Clippy, Cargo build, test execution, live Kafka/TLS/SASL qualification, performance benchmark, or production claim is implied.
The patch was reconstructed against v10 inputs alone; compatibility with newer composite changes was not tested by this review.
